`@interface UIDataOverlayRender`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataOverlayRender.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataOverlayRender.java)

When an overlay is drawn, set in the render option of @UIDataOverlay.

## Learn more

- [Overlays and popups](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/overlays-and-popups/#draw-an-overlay-above-the-screens-and-let-it-take-input)
- [Embedding JOID](/use/learn/running/embedding/)

## Elements

| Type | Element | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [always](#UIDataOverlayRender-element-always) | `false` | If `true`, the overlay is drawn even when the UI bridge hides the overlays. |
| `boolean` | [aboveScreens](#UIDataOverlayRender-element-aboveScreens) | `false` | If `true`, the overlay is drawn above the screens and the popups; if `false`, below them. |

## Element details

<a id="UIDataOverlayRender-element-always"></a>

### always

`boolean always() default false` 

If `true`, the overlay is drawn even when the UI bridge hides the overlays.

<a id="UIDataOverlayRender-element-aboveScreens"></a>

### aboveScreens

`boolean aboveScreens() default false` 

If `true`, the overlay is drawn above the screens and the popups; if `false`, below them.
